```{r}
#read in the dataset
chempop <- read.csv(here("data", "Chempop", "updated chempop", "river_health_atlas_analysis_ready.csv"))

colnames(chempop)

```

```{r}
chempop <- chempop %>%
  select(assemblage, sample_id, sample_date, sample_year, site_id, bio_site_id, site_label, sample_method, analysis_id, integration_unit, catchment, water_body, wfd_waterbody_id, reporting_area, easting, northing, longitude, latitude, taxon_richness, abundance_total, taxon_record_count, metric_count, metric_value_count, ept_taxon_richness, zinc_total_mean_6mo, copper_total_mean_6mo, cadmium_mean_6mo, chromium_mean_6mo, lead_mean_6mo, mercury_mean_6mo, nickel_mean_6mo, ph_mean_6mo, water_temperature_c_mean_6mo) %>% #select the columns that i want
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(sample_date)) %>% #make sure date is stored as a date
  filter(sample_date >= as.Date("2000-01-01")) %>% #filter for dates from 2000 onwards
filter(
    zinc_total_mean_6mo <= quantile(zinc_total_mean_6mo, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    copper_total_mean_6mo <= quantile(copper_total_mean_6mo, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)) #focus on the first 95% of data to make it easier to plot


chempop <- chempop %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("easting", "northing"),
    crs = 27700
  ) %>%
  st_transform(4326)
  
```

```{r}
lm1 <- lm(zinc_total_mean_6mo ~ sample_date, data = chempop)
summary(lm1)

lm2 <- lm(copper_total_mean_6mo ~ sample_date, data = chempop)
summary(lm2)
```

```{r}
#calculate the mean concentration for each site for each year
chempop_summaries <- chempop %>%
  group_by(sample_year, site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_zinc = mean(zinc_total_mean_6mo, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_copper = mean(copper_total_mean_6mo, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#one site in 2023 is stored as MULTIPOINT instead of POINT and this causes problems later. this fixes it:
chempop_summaries <- chempop_summaries %>%
  st_cast("POINT")

```

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Mean Zinc Concentrations"),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        inputId = "sample_year",
        label = "Select year:",
        choices = sort(unique(chempop_summaries$sample_year)),
        selected = min(chempop_summaries$sample_year)
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(
      leafletOutput("zinc_map", height = 700)
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Filter the data based on the selected year
  selected_year_data <- reactive({

    chempop_summaries %>%
      filter(.data$sample_year == input$sample_year)

  })

  # Initialise the map
  output$zinc_map <- renderLeaflet({

    leaflet() %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)

  })

  # Update the map whenever the year changes
  observe({

    data <- selected_year_data()

    pal <- colorNumeric(
      palette = "YlOrRd",
      domain = data$mean_zinc,
      na.color = "transparent"
    )

    leafletProxy("zinc_map", data = data) %>%

      clearMarkers() %>%
      clearControls() %>%

      addCircleMarkers(
        radius = 6,
        fillColor = ~pal(mean_zinc),
        fillOpacity = 0.8,
        color = "black",
        weight = 1,
        popup = ~paste0(
          "<b>Site:</b> ", site_id,
          "<br><b>Year:</b> ", sample_year,
          "<br><b>Mean zinc:</b> ",
          round(mean_zinc, 4),
          " µg/L"
        )
      ) %>%

      addLegend(
        pal = pal,
        values = ~mean_zinc,
        title = "Mean zinc (µg/L)",
        position = "bottomright"
      )

  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
uk <- ne_countries(
  country = "United Kingdom",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

uk <- st_transform(
  uk,
  st_crs(chempop_summaries)
)


uk_bbox <- c(
  xmin = -6,
  ymin = 49.5,
  xmax = 2,
  ymax = 59
)

roads <- opq(
  bbox = uk_bbox
) %>%

  add_osm_feature(
    key = "highway",
    value = c(
      "motorway",
      "trunk",
      "primary",
      "secondary"
    )
  ) %>%

  osmdata_sf()

uk_roads <- roads$osm_lines
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot() +

  # Roads
  geom_sf(
    data = uk_roads,
    aes(
      geometry = geometry
    ),
    linewidth = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  # Zinc points
  geom_sf(
    data = chempop_summaries,
    aes(
      colour = mean_zinc
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_colour_distiller(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    direction = 1,
    name = "Mean zinc (µg/L)",
    limits = range(
      chempop_summaries$mean_zinc,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Mean zinc concentrations: {frame_time}"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +

  transition_time(sample_year) +

  ease_aes("linear")


animation <- animate(
  p,
  fps = 2,
  duration = 10,
  width = 1000,
  height = 700,
  renderer = gifski_renderer()
)

animation
```
